This page lists the spec and status fields of Backup, BackupSchedule and Restore, each with its type, its limits and its description. The [Platform page](../../platform/disaster-recovery.md) explains the concept, and the `metadata` of every kind is [the same](../common-definitions.md#objectmeta).

## Backup

::include[../../../../api/types/v1alpha1/examples/disaster-recovery/backup.yaml#backup]

| apiVersion | kind |
| --- | --- |
| `funcd.io/v1alpha1` | `Backup` |

### `Backup.spec`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `schedule` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The BackupSchedule of the namespace whose scope, target and recipients the run uses, read when the run starts: a schedule gone by then fails the Backup with reason ScheduleNotFound. The schedule's status counts every Backup that names it. |
| `ttl` | string, a duration: whole numbers with the units h, m, s and ms, largest unit first (10m, 1h30m, 500ms) | How long funcd keeps the record after its creation; 0s or unset means the schedule's ttl, or 720h when the schedule does not exist. A ttl longer than the schedule's is refused. |

### `Backup.status`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `completionTime` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the run ended, Succeeded or Failed. |
| `conditions` | array of [Condition](../common-definitions.md#condition) | The conditions that explain the phase. |
| `expireTime` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When funcd deletes this record, once the run has ended: the Backup's creation plus its spec.ttl, else plus its schedule's ttl. The copy on the target stays until the target's own lifecycle rule removes it. |
| `members` | array of [`Backup.status.members[]`](#backupstatusmembers) | The stores the copy holds, which a Restore names as they are listed here. A Bucket's member holds none of the data of the Lakes located on its prefixes: each of them is a member of its own. |
| `observedGeneration` | integer | The generation of the spec that funcd last acted on. |
| `path` | string | The copy's directory on the target, &lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;backup&gt;-&lt;uid&gt;/. |
| `phase` | string, one of `Pending`, `Running`, `Paused`, `Succeeded`, `Failed`, `Cancelled` | Pending, then Running, then Succeeded or Failed, in one attempt: funcd does not retry a failed Backup. A Backup that was Running when funcd stopped ends at the next start, Succeeded with reason FoundOnTarget when its copy is whole on the target, else Failed with reason Interrupted. |
| `recipients` | array of string values | Fingerprints of the age recipients the copy is sealed to, sorted. A Restore whose identity matches none of them fails, its message naming both sets of fingerprints. A Backup recorded with reason FoundOnTarget lists none. |
| `startTime` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the run began. |
| `target` | string | The target URL the run wrote to: its schedule's spec.target.url at the time. A Restore reads the copy there. |

### `Backup.status.members[]`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bytes` | integer | The size of the member's sealed copy on the target, in bytes. |
| `kind` | string, required | The member's kind: KVStore, Bucket, Lake, SQLDatabase, or Function for a Function's local volume. |
| `name` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The member's name: the store's, or for a volume, its Function's. |
| `volume` | string, a DNS-1123 label | With kind Function, the name of the Function's local volume that the member is. |

## BackupSchedule

::include[../../../../api/types/v1alpha1/examples/disaster-recovery/backupschedule.yaml#backupschedule]

| apiVersion | kind |
| --- | --- |
| `funcd.io/v1alpha1` | `BackupSchedule` |

### `BackupSchedule.spec`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `encryption` | object, [`BackupSchedule.spec.encryption`](#backupschedulespecencryption) | The age recipients that seal the member files of each Backup. It is required: a schedule with fewer than 2 recipients is refused. |
| `paused` | boolean | While true, the schedule creates no Backup and rpoRisk stays false; a Backup created by hand still runs. Once it is false again, the slots missed meanwhile collapse into one Backup. |
| `schedule` | string, required | The cron slots at which the schedule creates a Backup: 5 fields (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week) or a macro such as @daily, in timeZone. Slots missed during downtime, a pause or a hold collapse into one Backup, and a slot that comes while one of the schedule's Backups is Pending or Running creates none. |
| `scope` | object, [`BackupSchedule.spec.scope`](#backupschedulespecscope), required | The stores each Backup copies, in one form: the lists kvStores, buckets, lakes, databases and volumes, or app, or resourceGroup. funcd resolves it at each run: a member or App it names that is missing then fails the Backup with reason MemberNotFound, and a scope of more than workloadBackup.maxCopyMembers members fails it with no copy written. In an App's spec.backupSchedules entry, an empty scope backs up that App. |
| `target` | object, [`BackupSchedule.spec.target`](#backupschedulespectarget), required | Where each Backup writes its copy: an S3 bucket and the Secret of its write key. |
| `timeZone` | string | The IANA time zone of schedule, such as Europe/Paris; UTC when empty. |
| `ttl` | string, a duration: whole numbers with the units h, m, s and ms, largest unit first (10m, 1h30m, 500ms) | How long funcd keeps each Backup's record after its creation; 0s or unset means 720h. Only the record goes: the copy stays on the target until the target's own lifecycle rule expires it. A Backup may set a shorter spec.ttl, never a longer one. |

### `BackupSchedule.spec.encryption`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `recipients` | array of string values, required | The age recipients, each entry one recipient: at least 2 distinct ones, such as an owner's and a recovery one, all X25519 or all hybrid (age1pq1). Every member file of each Backup is sealed to all of them, so the identity of any one opens it. The copy's manifest.yaml, which names the members, their files' sizes and these recipients' fingerprints, is not sealed. |

### `BackupSchedule.spec.scope`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `app` | string, a DNS-1123 label | An App of the namespace: each Backup copies the stores of its kv, buckets, lakes and sql entries, ref entries included, and the local volumes of the Functions it declares. Set it alone, with no other scope field. |
| `buckets` | array of string values, each a DNS-1123 label | Buckets of the namespace to copy, by name, each once. A Bucket's copy holds none of the data of the Lakes located on its prefixes: each of them is copied as a member of its own. |
| `databases` | array of string values, each a DNS-1123 label | SQLDatabases of the namespace to copy, by name, each once. A database whose engine is not Ready fails the Backup with reason EngineNotReady. |
| `kvStores` | array of string values, each a DNS-1123 label | KVStores of the namespace to copy, by name, each once. |
| `lakes` | array of string values, each a DNS-1123 label | Lakes of the namespace to copy, by name, each once. A Lake located on a prefix of a listed Bucket is copied without being named here. A Lake that deletes files during each of a run's copies, as a busy one may, fails the Backup with reason LakeUnstable, and so does a Bucket that brings it in. |
| `resourceGroup` | string, a DNS-1123 label | A resource group of the namespace: each Backup copies its KVStores, Buckets, Lakes and SQLDatabases, but not its Functions' local volumes. Set it alone, with no other scope field. |
| `volumes` | array of string values | Local volumes of the namespace's Functions to copy, each as &lt;function&gt;/&lt;name&gt;, both DNS-1123 labels, and listed once. A volume is read live, file by file, so its copy is not a single point in time. |

### `BackupSchedule.spec.target`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `credentialsSecret` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | A Secret of the namespace with AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and, optionally, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN: the key each Backup writes with. It needs only put and list on the bucket. |
| `url` | string, required | The s3:// URL of the bucket that receives the copies, its options as query parameters, such as s3://backups?region=eu-west-3. The bucket of blob.target is refused, and another bucket on its endpoint is accepted with reason SameProvider on the schedule's Ready condition: one failure of that provider takes both. The bucket must accept a create-if-absent put (If-None-Match: \*): a bucket that refuses it fails each Backup with reason TargetUnconditional. |

### `BackupSchedule.status`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `active` | string, a DNS-1123 label | A Backup of the schedule that is Pending or Running, empty when none is. |
| `conditions` | array of [Condition](../common-definitions.md#condition) | The conditions that explain the phase. |
| `earliestRestorePoint` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the oldest of the schedule's Succeeded Backups that still exist started: the oldest point a Restore can go back to. |
| `lastScheduleTime` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | The newest slot the schedule has taken, whether it created a Backup or, finding one of its Backups still Pending or Running, created none. |
| `lastSuccessTime` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the newest of the schedule's Succeeded Backups that still exist completed. |
| `observedGeneration` | integer | The generation of the spec that funcd last acted on. |
| `phase` | string, one of `Pending`, `Deploying`, `Ready`, `Idle`, `Degraded`, `Failed`, `Terminating` | Where the object is in its lifecycle. |
| `rpoRisk` | boolean | True when the schedule has fallen behind: the first slot after the start of its newest Succeeded Backup, or after its creation when there is none, has passed with that slot's Backup Failed or missing, or a second slot has passed. It stays false while the schedule is paused. funcd logs workload backup rpo at risk when it turns true. |

## Restore

::include[../../../../api/types/v1alpha1/examples/disaster-recovery/restore.yaml#restore]

| apiVersion | kind |
| --- | --- |
| `funcd.io/v1alpha1` | `Restore` |

### `Restore.spec`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `backup` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The Backup to load, in the Restore's namespace. The Restore waits while it is Pending or Running, and fails with reason BackupNotReady when it is missing or Failed. |
| `members` | array of [`Restore.spec.members[]`](#restorespecmembers), required | The members of the Backup to load, at least one and each once, loaded in this order after funcd has checked the whole copy and every destination. A Bucket's member leaves its destination's Lake prefixes as they are: to restore those Lakes, name them as members too. |
| `source` | object, [`Restore.spec.source`](#restorespecsource), required | The Secrets that read the Backup's copy and open its seal. |

### `Restore.spec.members[]`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `as` | string, a DNS-1123 label | The destination: the name of an existing, empty store of the member's kind in the namespace, or for a volume, of a Function whose local volume of that name is empty. A SQLDatabase is empty with no table, view, index or trigger and no Function binding it. Exactly one of as, asLocation and inPlace; a Lake takes asLocation or inPlace. |
| `asLocation` | object, [`Restore.spec.members[].asLocation`](#restorespecmembersaslocation) | For a Lake: the bucket and prefix that receive its copy, where no Lake is located and nothing is stored yet; a Lake located there afterwards reads it. The bucket must exist and may not be one this Restore restores in place. Exactly one of as, asLocation and inPlace. |
| `inPlace` | boolean | Load the member back into its own store, replacing its data; a Function's volume is loaded only when empty or named by its Function's DataMissing condition. The Restore then needs update on the Namespace, as an admin has, and another in-place Restore of the namespace is refused until it ends. It first takes the export Backup that status.export names, which needs the restored Backup's schedule, then holds the namespace while it loads: a failed load keeps the hold until funcdctl hold release --namespace. Exactly one of as, asLocation and inPlace. |
| `kind` | string, required | The member's kind, as the Backup's status.members lists it: KVStore, Bucket, Lake, SQLDatabase, or Function for a Function's local volume. |
| `name` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The member's name, as the Backup's status.members lists it: the store's, or for a volume, its Function's. A member the copy does not hold fails the Restore with reason MemberNotFound. |
| `volume` | string, a DNS-1123 label | With kind Function, which needs it, the name of the Function's local volume that the member is. Any other kind takes none. |

### `Restore.spec.members[].asLocation`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bucket` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | A Bucket of the same namespace. |
| `prefix` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | A prefix of that Bucket. |

### `Restore.spec.source`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `credentialsSecret` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | A Secret of the namespace with AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY and, optionally, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN: the key the Restore reads the copy with, at the Backup's status.target. A read-only key is enough. |
| `identitySecret` | string, a DNS-1123 label | A Secret of the namespace whose AGE_IDENTITY key holds age identities, X25519 or hybrid and not passphrase-encrypted, one of them for a recipient the Backup is sealed to. It is required: a Restore without it is refused. |

### `Restore.status`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `completionTime` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the Restore ended, Succeeded or Failed. |
| `conditions` | array of [Condition](../common-definitions.md#condition) | The conditions that explain the phase. |
| `export` | string, a DNS-1123 label | The Backup that an in-place Restore takes before it loads, &lt;restore&gt;-before, of the restored Backup's schedule. Empty when no member is in place. |
| `observedGeneration` | integer | The generation of the spec that funcd last acted on. |
| `phase` | string, one of `Pending`, `Running`, `Paused`, `Succeeded`, `Failed`, `Cancelled` | Pending while it waits for its Backup and, in place, for its export; Running while it checks the whole copy and loads; then Succeeded or Failed. A Restore that was Running when funcd stopped ends Failed with reason Interrupted. |
| `startTime` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the Restore turned Running, once its Backup and any export had Succeeded. |

### Read the hold and its evidence

| Method | Path | Operation ID | Authentication |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/apis/funcd.io/v1alpha1/hold` | `getHold` | `bearer` or `apiKey` |

Answer: [`Evidence`](#evidence).

| Status | Problem type | When | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 200 |  | OK |  |
| 401 | `urn:funcd:problem:unauthorized` | The request carries no bearer token or API key, or one that funcd does not know. | Send a credential of funcd's config as a bearer token in the Authorization header, or in X-Api-Key. |
| 403 | `urn:funcd:problem:forbidden` | The credential's role does not allow it to read the hold: only an admin's does. | Use an admin's credential. |

#### `Evidence`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bucketOrphans` | array of string values | The Buckets that do not exist and whose objects funcd still holds, each as &lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;name&gt;. |
| `counts` | map of string to integer | The number of objects of each kind that funcd stores now, to compare with the counts of report. |
| `deadLetters` | array of string values | The dead letters of every namespace, each as &lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;id&gt;. Nothing delivers them again by itself. |
| `functionsNotReady` | array of string values | The Functions whose phase is not Ready, each as &lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;name&gt;. |
| `held` | boolean, required | True while the platform is held: its timers, blob sources, Sensors, runs, rollouts, backups and sweeps wait for the release. |
| `marker` | object, [`Evidence.marker`](#evidencemarker) | Why the platform is held, and since when; absent when it is not held. |
| `namespaces` | array of [`Evidence.namespaces[]`](#evidencenamespaces) | The holds of single namespaces, one for each reason that holds a namespace. |
| `orphans` | array of string values | The KV data that no object names: the prefix of each KVStore that does not exist, as &lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;store&gt;/, and of each table that its KVStore no longer declares, as &lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;store&gt;/&lt;table&gt;/. To keep that data, apply its object while the platform is held. |
| `pausedRuns` | array of string values | The WorkflowRuns that are paused and have not ended, each as &lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;name&gt;. A release leaves them paused, and funcdctl workflow resume runs one again. |
| `pending` | map of string to object | For each blob EventSource, as &lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;name&gt;, how many objects of each event the release fires, since the source has not seen them yet. |
| `quarantine` | array of [`Evidence.quarantine[]`](#evidencequarantine) | The data that a start moved into the quarantine, since no object named it, held or not. |
| `releasedAt` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the last release lifted the platform's hold. |
| `report` | any JSON value | The report of funcd restore run, as it wrote restore.json: the generation that it loaded, the counts of its objects per kind, and the WorkflowRuns that it paused. Absent when no restore wrote one. |
| `sqlOrphans` | array of string values | The SQL databases that do not exist and whose directory funcd still holds, each as &lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;name&gt;. |
| `volumeOrphans` | array of string values | The local volumes that no stored Function declares, each as &lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;function&gt;/&lt;volume&gt;. |

#### `Evidence.marker`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reason` | string, required | Why it is held: restore or safe-mode for the platform; for a namespace, data, which funcd restore run sets on a namespace with a BackupSchedule, or restore, which an in-place Restore sets while it loads. |
| `restore` | string, a DNS-1123 label | For the restore hold of a namespace, the in-place Restore that set it. |
| `since` | string, required, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the hold began. |

#### `Evidence.namespaces[]`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `namespace` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The namespace that is held. |
| `phase` | string, one of `Pending`, `Running`, `Paused`, `Succeeded`, `Failed`, `Cancelled` | The phase of the Restore that restore names; empty once that Restore is deleted. |
| `reason` | string, required | Why it is held: restore or safe-mode for the platform; for a namespace, data, which funcd restore run sets on a namespace with a BackupSchedule, or restore, which an in-place Restore sets while it loads. |
| `restore` | string, a DNS-1123 label | For the restore hold of a namespace, the in-place Restore that set it. |
| `since` | string, required, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the hold began. |

#### `Evidence.quarantine[]`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | string, required | The kind of the object whose data the entry holds: KVStore, Bucket, SQLDatabase, or Function for a local volume. |
| `name` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The object's name; for a volume, its Function's. |
| `namespace` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The object's namespace. |
| `since` | string, required, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the start began to move the data into the quarantine. |
| `state` | string, required | The entry's state: moving while a start moves the data in, kept once all of it is in, and returning while a return brings it back. |
| `until` | string, required, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the sweep may delete the entry: since plus storage.quarantineRetention. |
| `volume` | string, a DNS-1123 label | With kind Function, the name of the local volume. |

### Release the hold of the platform or of namespaces

| Method | Path | Operation ID | Authentication |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `POST` | `/apis/funcd.io/v1alpha1/hold/release` | `releaseHold` | `bearer` or `apiKey` |

Body: [`HoldReleaseInputBody`](#holdreleaseinputbody), required. Answer: none.

| Status | Problem type | When | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 204 |  | No Content |  |
| 400 | `urn:funcd:problem:invalid` | The body sets both advance and namespaces: advance applies to the release of the platform's hold only. | Release the platform and the namespaces in two calls. |
| 400 | `urn:funcd:problem:invalid` | An entry of advance does not name, as &lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;name&gt;, an EventSource with a blob event. | Name only blob EventSources, as funcdctl hold status lists them under pending. |
| 400 | `about:blank` | The body is missing or is not JSON. | Send a JSON body. |
| 401 | `urn:funcd:problem:unauthorized` | The request carries no bearer token or API key, or one that funcd does not know. | Send a credential of funcd's config as a bearer token in the Authorization header, or in X-Api-Key. |
| 403 | `urn:funcd:problem:forbidden` | The credential's role does not allow it to release a hold: only an admin's does. | Use an admin's credential. |
| 409 | `urn:funcd:problem:conflict` | The body names no namespace, and the platform is not held. | There is nothing to release: funcdctl hold status shows what is held. |
| 409 | `urn:funcd:problem:conflict` | A namespace of the body is not held; the namespaces before it are released. | Release the namespaces after it again, without it. |
| 409 | `urn:funcd:problem:conflict` | A namespace of the body is held by an in-place Restore that is Pending or Running; the namespaces before it are released. | Release the namespaces after it again; release this one once the Restore has ended. |
| 413 | `urn:funcd:problem:payload-too-large` | The body is larger than 1 MiB. | Send a smaller body. |
| 415 | `about:blank` | The Content-Type of the body is not JSON. | Send the body as application/json. |
| 422 | `about:blank` | The query holds a parameter that the operation does not take. | Send only the parameters that the operation lists. |
| 422 | `about:blank` | The body breaks the schema: a field that it does not know, of the wrong type or past its limits. | Correct the field at the location that the detail gives, such as body.spec.tables. |

#### `HoldReleaseInputBody`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `advance` | array of string values | With the release of the platform's hold: the blob EventSources, each as &lt;namespace&gt;/&lt;name&gt;, whose pending objects the release marks seen instead of firing them. |
| `namespaces` | array of string values, each a DNS-1123 label | The namespaces whose hold to release, instead of the platform's: the hold for its data that funcd restore run sets on a namespace with a BackupSchedule, and the hold that an in-place Restore keeps when its load does not complete. |

### Read the status of the platform backup

| Method | Path | Operation ID | Authentication |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/apis/funcd.io/v1alpha1/platformbackup` | `getPlatformBackup` | `bearer` or `apiKey` |

Answer: [`PlatformBackupStatus`](#platformbackupstatus).

| Status | Problem type | When | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 200 |  | OK |  |
| 401 | `urn:funcd:problem:unauthorized` | The request carries no bearer token or API key, or one that funcd does not know. | Send a credential of funcd's config as a bearer token in the Authorization header, or in X-Api-Key. |
| 403 | `urn:funcd:problem:forbidden` | The credential's role does not allow it to read the status of the platform backup: only an admin's does. | Use an admin's credential. |
| 503 | `urn:funcd:problem:unavailable` | funcd could not list backup.target, where the platform backup writes: the bucket does not exist, the URL is wrong, or the target fails. | Check backup.target and the key of backup.credentialsFile, then read the status again. |

#### `PlatformBackupStatus`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `earliestRestorePoint` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the oldest generation that funcd restore run can load was written. |
| `enabled` | boolean, required | True when funcd runs the platform backup, which needs backup.target and storage.mode file. |
| `held` | boolean, required | True while the platform is held: the backups wait for the release. It reads false, as interval and rpo read 0s, when funcd runs no backup: under storage.mode memory, or with neither backup.target nor kvstore.backup.enabled set. |
| `interval` | string, required, a duration: whole numbers with the units h, m, s and ms, largest unit first (10m, 1h30m, 500ms) | How often the platform backup runs: backup.interval; 0s when funcd runs no backup. |
| `lastFailure` | object, [`PlatformBackupStatus.lastFailure`](#platformbackupstatuslastfailure) | The last run that failed since funcd started; a run that succeeds clears it. |
| `lastSuccessTime` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the newest complete generation on the target was written. |
| `lastVerifiedTime` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the newest generation that funcdctl backup verify checked was written; absent when none is verified or its original has expired. |
| `nextRunTime` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the next run is due. |
| `rpo` | string, required, a duration: whole numbers with the units h, m, s and ms, largest unit first (10m, 1h30m, 500ms) | The most data that a loss may take: backup.objectives.rpo; 0s when funcd runs no backup. |
| `rpoRisk` | boolean, required | True when the platform backup is on and no verified generation is newer than backup.objectives.rpo; funcd then logs backup rpo at risk, and funcdctl backup verify clears it. |
| `streams` | map of string to [`PlatformBackupStatus.streams.*`](#platformbackupstatusstreams) | The runs of the other backups since funcd started, by stream: blob for the mirror of Blob's files, kv for the KV backup. |

#### `PlatformBackupStatus.lastFailure`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `error` | string, required | Why the run failed. |
| `time` | string, required, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the run ended. |

#### `PlatformBackupStatus.streams.*`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lastFailure` | object, [`PlatformBackupStatus.lastFailure`](#platformbackupstatuslastfailure) | The stream's last run that failed; a run that succeeds clears it. |
| `lastSuccessTime` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the stream's last run that succeeded ended. |

### Return quarantined data into its object

| Method | Path | Operation ID | Authentication |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `POST` | `/apis/funcd.io/v1alpha1/quarantine/return` | `returnQuarantined` | `bearer` or `apiKey` |

Body: [`QuarantineReturn`](#quarantinereturn), required. Answer: none.

| Status | Problem type | When | What to do |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 204 |  | No Content |  |
| 400 | `urn:funcd:problem:invalid` | The kind is none of KVStore, Bucket and Function. | Send KVStore, Bucket, or Function with the volume; a SQL database's directory goes back by hand, with funcd stopped. |
| 400 | `urn:funcd:problem:invalid` | The kind is Function and the body names no volume, or it names a volume with another kind. | Name the volume with kind Function only. |
| 400 | `about:blank` | The body is missing or is not JSON. | Send a JSON body. |
| 401 | `urn:funcd:problem:unauthorized` | The request carries no bearer token or API key, or one that funcd does not know. | Send a credential of funcd's config as a bearer token in the Authorization header, or in X-Api-Key. |
| 403 | `urn:funcd:problem:forbidden` | The credential's role does not allow it to return quarantined data: only an admin's does. | Use an admin's credential. |
| 404 | `urn:funcd:problem:not-found` | The quarantine holds no entry of the object, or none of that since, that is kept or returning; a moving entry, which a failed move leaves, does not return. | Read the entries under quarantine in funcdctl hold status; a moving entry returns once a later start of funcd has finished its move. |
| 409 | `urn:funcd:problem:conflict` | The KVStore, the Bucket or the Function does not exist, or the Function declares no local volume of that name. | Apply the KVStore or the Bucket again, or the Function with the volume in its spec.volumes, then return its data. |
| 409 | `urn:funcd:problem:conflict` | The object holds data: an entry returns only into an empty KVStore, Bucket or volume. | Delete what the object holds, if it is not needed, then return its data. |
| 413 | `urn:funcd:problem:payload-too-large` | The body is larger than 1 MiB. | Send a smaller body. |
| 415 | `about:blank` | The Content-Type of the body is not JSON. | Send the body as application/json. |
| 422 | `about:blank` | The query holds a parameter that the operation does not take. | Send only the parameters that the operation lists. |
| 422 | `about:blank` | The body breaks the schema: a field that it does not know, of the wrong type or past its limits. | Correct the field at the location that the detail gives, such as body.spec.tables. |
| 503 | `urn:funcd:problem:unavailable` | This funcd server keeps no quarantine of that kind, such as of volumes while volumes are off. | Check the kind: funcdctl hold status lists the entries of the quarantine. |

#### `QuarantineReturn`

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | string, required | The object's kind: KVStore, Bucket, or Function for a Function's local volume. |
| `name` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The object's name; for a volume, its Function's. |
| `namespace` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The object's namespace. |
| `since` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | The entry to return, by its since as funcdctl hold status lists it. Left out, a return that was cut short resumes first, else the object's newest kept entry returns. |
| `volume` | string, a DNS-1123 label | With kind Function, the name of the local volume. |
